name: Bookvara (Vara)
tagline: All-in-one scheduling and payments for service businesses — appointments, clients, staff, and reporting in one place.
description:
Bookvara (branded as Vara) is full-stack SaaS for service businesses that otherwise juggle separate tools for booking, payments, clients, and staff. Owners get online appointments, service and product catalogs, client history, built-in payments, and real-time reporting so day-to-day operations stay in one system.

The product targets medspas, beauty, wellness, and professional services — high-touch businesses that need tight schedules, accurate checkout, and client records without stitching calendars and payment processors together by hand.

coverImage.alt: Bookvara (Vara) — scheduling and payments platform for service businesses

problem: Service businesses run on appointments and payments, but owners often pay for one tool for the calendar, another for cards, and another for client notes. Double-booking, slow checkout, and fragmented history become daily friction.
approach: Ship a single operational surface for bookings, services, clients, staff availability, and payments. Optimize for how service businesses actually work — packages, memberships, retail add-ons, and staff schedules — instead of a generic calendar widget.
solution: An all-in-one platform where clients book online, staff availability stays live, services and products are managed centrally, payments happen in-product, and dashboards show revenue, appointments, and staff productivity.
features: Online appointment scheduling with cancellation and availability controls
Services, add-ons, memberships, and retail products in one catalog
Client profiles with visit history, preferences, and notes
Built-in payments for cards and digital wallets
Reporting dashboards for revenue and appointment performance
architecture: Classic multi-tenant SaaS: booking and staff calendars share a client and services data model; payments sit on the same checkout path as appointments; reporting aggregates operational events into dashboards for owners.
